title: Starwheel Manufacturing CAD Validation Standards Registry
description: Authoritative engineering constraints, machinery ratings, and regulatory standards for bottle-capper starwheel validation.

metadata.scope: Rotary starwheels and packaging container handling change parts

starwheel.description: Rotary transfer wheel with N pockets on a bolt circle (PCD); carries containers through the capper turret.
starwheel.cadquery_strategy: disk extrude -> bore cutThruAll -> N pocket circles cutThruAll on the PCD

feed_screw.description: Infeed timing screw: helical flight on a root cylinder that separates and paces containers into the starwheel at exactly one container per pitch per start.
feed_screw.cadquery_strategy: root cylinder extrude -> rectangular flight profile swept along cq.Wire.makeHelix(pitch, length, root_radius) with isFrenet=True (one helix per start) -> union. twistExtrude is NOT valid: it only rotates the end face and cannot form a multi-turn helix (verified on OCCT).

guide_rail.description: Curved outer guide rail that holds containers in the starwheel pockets around part of the turret arc.
guide_rail.cadquery_strategy: annular-sector sketch (inner arc, outer arc via threePointArc) -> extrude by rail_height_mm

CAP-12.reference_source: Morrison Container Handling Solutions Equipment Manual Table 3.2

CAP-16.reference_source: Morrison Container Handling Solutions Capper Series Spec 16-PCD620 (Back-solved from 380 CPM at 0.844 utilisation = 450.2 CPM)

CAP-24.reference_source: PMMI Packaging Machinery High-Speed Turret Design Guide

AROL-EURO-16.reference_source: Arol PK Series Technical Data Sheet

ZALKIN-CA-16.reference_source: Zalkin Rotary Capper Operating & Maintenance Guide

container_defaults.notes: Defaults for load/torque estimates when the customer spec omits them: 500 ml PET filled mass, PET-on-UHMW sliding friction, and typical infeed accumulation back-pressure from a backed-up conveyor.

feed_screw_thresholds.pocket_width_rule: pocket_width = pitch - flight_thickness; clearance = pocket_width - bottle_diameter; effective_clearance = clearance - ovality/2 (strict > min_effective_clearance_mm, same ISBT floor as starwheel pockets)
feed_screw_thresholds.torque_model: T = dynamic_load_factor * (bottles_engaged * mu * m * g + accumulation_backpressure_n) * (outer_diameter/2); screw_rpm = target_cpm / starts
feed_screw_thresholds.reference_source: Morrison Feed Screw Design Standard FS-DS-02 (pocket timing tolerance, flight engagement, drive sizing)

guide_rail_thresholds.running_gap_rule: gap = rail_inner_radius - mating_pcd/2 - bottle_diameter/2; effective_gap = gap - ovality/2 (strict > min_effective_clearance_mm)
guide_rail_thresholds.load_model: radial load = bottles_in_arc * m * omega^2 * (pcd/2), omega from starwheel rpm = cpm / N; must not exceed material allowable_contact_load_n
guide_rail_thresholds.reference_source: Morrison Guide Rail Design Standard GR-DS-01 (rail wrap limit for changeover access, contact on cylindrical label panel only)

UHMW-PE.name: Ultra-High Molecular Weight Polyethylene
UHMW-PE.eu_regulation_citation: EU Regulation (EU) No 10/2011, Annex I (FCM No. 233)
UHMW-PE.notes: Industry standard for starwheel pockets; self-lubricating, non-marking on PET and glass.

POM.name: Polyoxymethylene / Acetal (Delrin)
POM.eu_regulation_citation: EU Regulation (EU) No 10/2011, Annex I (FCM No. 343)
POM.notes: High dimensional stability; ideal for precision pocket geometry and hot-fill lines.

PTFE.name: Polytetrafluoroethylene (Teflon)
PTFE.eu_regulation_citation: EU Regulation (EU) No 10/2011, Annex I (FCM No. 278)
PTFE.notes: Chemically inert; used in aggressive CIP (clean-in-place) washdown and acidic beverage bottling.

PEEK.name: Polyetheretherketone
PEEK.eu_regulation_citation: EU Regulation (EU) No 10/2011, Annex I (FCM No. 741)
PEEK.notes: Premium high-temperature, high-strength thermoplastic for extreme duty packaging.

mild steel.name: Carbon Steel / Mild Steel (uncoated)
mild steel.fda_cfr_citation: Not Permitted under 21 CFR § 174.5 / 175.300 without certified sanitary barrier
mild steel.eu_regulation_citation: Non-compliant with Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 Art. 3 (Corrosion & ion migration risk)
mild steel.notes: Direct container contact prohibited; rusts on wet lines, contaminates product.

unpainted aluminum.name: Raw Industrial Aluminum Alloy (6061-T6 uncoated)
unpainted aluminum.fda_cfr_citation: 21 CFR § 175.300 (Requires compliant anodized or polymeric barrier coating)
unpainted aluminum.eu_regulation_citation: Council of Europe Resolution CM/Res(2013)9 on metals and alloys
unpainted aluminum.notes: Pitted by caustic washdown solutions; aluminum black transfer onto PET bottles.

brass.name: Machining Brass (Leaded)
brass.fda_cfr_citation: Prohibited in direct food/beverage contact due to lead leaching risk (FDA CPG Sec. 500.500)
brass.eu_regulation_citation: Prohibited under RoHS and EU No 1935/2004

geometric_thresholds.clearance_reference_source: ISBT Voluntary Plastic Packaging Guidelines Section 4.3; historic failure analysis precedent SW-10884
geometric_thresholds.clearance_binding_failure_mode: Effective clearance <= 0.20mm causes bottle binding at speeds > 300 CPM when container thermal expansion and ovality exhaust radial tolerance.
geometric_thresholds.web_reference_source: Morrison Machinery Design Standard SW-STR-01: minimum continuous material ligament between pocket cutouts to prevent deflection under dynamic bottle centrifugal forces.
astm_standards: ASTM D2911: Standard Specification for Dimensions and Tolerances of Plastic Bottles
ASTM D2561: Environmental Stress-Crack Resistance of Blown Polyethylene Containers
